# 33 JavaScript Concepts Archive

This repository is a local copy of the open-source project **33 Concepts Every JavaScript Developer Should Know**.

## Canonical upstream project

- Original project: https://github.com/leonardomso/33-js-concepts
- Original maintainer: Leonardo Maldonado
- Original inspiration: Stephen Curtis's article on JavaScript fundamentals
- License: MIT

## Status

This repository is not the canonical source, official issue tracker, or authoritative update channel for the project.

The collection contains links to third-party articles, videos, books, and documentation. Those resources may move, change, become outdated, or use licenses separate from this repository's MIT license.

For current links, translations, contributions, and project history, use the upstream repository.

## Learning scope

The collection covers 33 JavaScript topics including:

- call stack and execution context
- primitive and reference values
- coercion and equality
- scope and closures
- modules and namespaces
- event loop and timers
- prototypes and classes
- functional programming concepts
- promises and async/await
- data structures and algorithms
- design patterns and clean code
